name: Tempest
title: Color X-Y Power Supply

mains.selection: Voltage selection blocks: violet 100V, yellow 120V, grey 200V, blue 220V, brown 240V
mains.inlet: J1 -> FL1 line filter -> F1 -> J2 to on/off and interlock switches
mains.F1: 7A slow-blow 250V (use 4A slow-blow at 220V and 240V — European only)

note: Thermal cutout on the transformer primary opens at 110 +/- 5 C. A dead machine with good mains and an open F3 (20A, 32V) points at the low-voltage high-current rail rather than the logic supply.
